notes.title: Ways V1.2 (Update 2) - 01/06/2025
notes.notes:
[b]Bug fixes :[/b]
- Fixed a bug that caused an item to disappear after the player's death.
- The camera bug after player death has been resolved.
- The bug that caused the flashlight to disappear has been fixed.
- Other minor bugs have been resolved.

[b]Additions / Deletions :[/b]
- An overlay appears on certain objects to help the player interact.
- Addition of an arrow in the elevator on level 2.
- Addition of sound effects in level 0.
- Addition of sound effects in the Hotel.
- Addition of a new puzzle in ventilations
- The maintenance room on level 2 has been modified.
- Credits have been modified and are now available in-game.
- A new room has been added on level 2.
- Added indications of directional movements for the player.
- The electric box puzzle on level 2 has been slightly modified.
- Monster speed in level 4 has been slightly reduced.

[b]Other :[/b]
- Some sound effects have been modified.

[b]And happy new year to all![/b]

notes.title: Ways V1.1 (Update1) - 12/24/2024
notes.notes:
[b]Bug fixes :[/b]
- The bug in the language settings has been fixed.
- The bug that caused checkpoints to crash has been fixed.
- The main character can no longer advance during the antagonist's spawn.
- The flashlight bug at the end of chases has been corrected.
- The flashlight bug after the death of the main character has been corrected.
- The bug that caused the trapdoor not to open after the main character's death has been corrected.
- The bug that caused voice-lines and subtitles to disappear has been corrected.
- The bug that caused sparks to appear infinitely in level 1 has been corrected.
- The bug where tapes stopped when you moved too far away has been solved.

[b]Additions / Deletions :[/b]
- Sensitivity settings have been removed.
- A new icon appears when the main character can interact.
- Added a sticker in the Fusebox to help players better understand the keys (right-click).
- Added missing subtitles at the end of the game.

[b]Others :[/b]
- The settings menu has been modified.
- The pause menu has been modified.
- Key Mapping has been modified (WASD).

[b]And a merry Christmas to all![/b]
